placeholders.{objectTypeId.site}: objectTypeId in the response of the create-schema request for this object (schemas.json).
placeholders.{objectTypeId.project}: objectTypeId in the response of the create-schema request for this object (schemas.json).
placeholders.{objectTypeId.estimate}: objectTypeId in the response of the create-schema request for this object (schemas.json).

body.name: site
body.description: A physical location where work is done, with access and induction needs. One client can have many sites, and one site can host several projects over the years. Holds no personal data.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Site name or street, for example the high street unit. Use a place name, never a person's name.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.site}.

body.name: project
body.description: One awarded job on one site, from pre-start to close-out and the defects period. Created when a tender or quote is won. Owned by the project manager, not the estimator.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Client and site, for example the client and the high street unit fit-out.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.project}.

body.name: estimate
body.description: One priced revision of a bid or quote. A deal can have several, so price history and margin are kept without overwriting the deal amount.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Deal name and revision, for example the high street unit fit-out, revision 2.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.estimate}.
